news.title: [正面] Morimens might be most generous gacha game on the...
news.summary:
Morimens might be most generous gacha game on the market, and it's a game worth taking advantage of that generosity for. 

I think the story is a little bit weak in the beginning (and the end of arc1 felt rushed), but the characters/ gameplay carry it for me. The aesthetic and themes in here are top notch, and the music conveys this game's tone quite well. 

The deets:
 - The way this game has massaged the sensibilities of Lovecraftian horror into game mechanics is very cool. 
 - Awakeners being good at low investment/dupes are good. There are enough of them in this game that I'm bringing it up.
 - Low effort dailies, as well as a more involved rotating gauntlet mode that makes deliberate planning/team building feel rewarding. This is super helpful for managing the time investment with Morimens. 
 - Guaranteed SSR at 30 pulls. Even if you miss the 50/50, your account is improving.
 - Roguelike deckbuilders are neat, even if this one is a little less insistent on the roguelike aspect of the genre (rewarding investment/build quality a little bit more than its contemporaries). 


I'd recommend playing this on mobile, but I'm on here every once in a while to reduce eye strain. Seamless account linking was also a plus.
